items.text: The NIFTY 500 fell 0.8% on 18 Nov. Telecommunication was the strongest sector (−0.2%) and Diversified the weakest (−1.4%).

FIIs bought a net ₹4,195 Cr and DIIs bought a net ₹197 Cr of Indian shares on 17 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 57 niches; Lubricants & Specialty Oils, Staffing & HR Services and Electricals, Lighting & Electronics joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Small PSU Banks and Housing Finance - Affordable.
